text: Ko ɓen Annabaaɓe ɗon woni ɓe men Okki Defte, e Ñenƴal, e Annabaaku. Si yimɓe maa ɓen yeddii ko Men Addani ɓe kon e ɗin tati, gomɗii Men Hebilanii ɗi yimɓe goo ɓe laataaki yeddooɓe ɗi ; ɓen ko gomɗimɓe jaɓooɓe ɗi, ko ɓen woni feruɓe ɓen e yimɓe madiina ɓen jokkirɓe ɓe moƴƴere haa Ñalnde njoɓdi diina.
